integrity.claim: The canonical payload hash detects accidental or unrecomputed edits; it is not a signature, MAC, identity proof, or authenticity proof. A person who edits the payload can recompute it.

comparison.signalValuePolicy: finite normalized numeric canonical signals from the exact allowlist only; no free text is compared
comparison.independencePolicy: codeId and canonical profile payload fingerprint must both differ

lifecycle.expiry: comparison rejects a code at or after expiresAt
lifecycle.clock: canonical UTC timestamps are checked against caller-supplied or current device time; no trusted server clock is claimed
lifecycle.withdraw: withdrawal adds the codeId to the caller-maintained active revocation set; every later comparison must pass that set and rejects the code
lifecycle.delete: the receipt marks deletion as caller-action-required because the stateless engine has no storage handle
lifecycle.exportedCopyLimit: withdrawal cannot remotely revoke copies another person already exported or a caller that deliberately omits prior revocations
